report: We're 2-7 and need to win now. The lineup is mostly set. Rhamondre Stevenson is Questionable and plays at 1:30 PM Sunday against DET, whose run defense ranks 30th (1 = allows the most). Woody Marks is the backup if he is ruled out, but I'd keep Stevenson in unless he is declared out. Our weak spots are TE (LaPorta, 5.5 over his last 3) and a RB2 who averages only 9.74 (White). The key trade is for a RB from TWILL4, who has RB depth, and we give him a WR he can start. Send that one first, then work down the board.

team_breakdown.note: Stafford averages 15.87 and is down to 12.33 over his last 3, but he faces ARI, which gives up the 2nd-most to QBs.
Javonte Williams is strong at 17.73 with 23 carries a game, but White averages 9.74 and Stevenson is Questionable.
Higgins averages 19.98 and 28.17 over his last 3, and McMillan and J. Williams are solid, but the WR depth is thin.
LaPorta averages 11.64 but only 5.5 over his last 3, so the position is a slump with no strong replacement.
Stevenson and J. Williams fill the flex spots, with Flournoy (9.31) as the next man up.
Nobody on the bench averages above 9.31 and most backup RBs are under 6, so the bench has no real scoring depth.

plan: Upgrade RB2 from White (9.74) to a 12+ PPG back using bench WR depth.
Find a steadier TE than LaPorta's 5.5 last-3 average.
Package bench pieces for a starter-level RB so a Stevenson injury doesn't sink the lineup.

replacements.why: Marks has 17.3 carries per game and a steady 8.28 floor.
